questions.questionText:

the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

because they knew greatness would come through great responsibilities.

of the time success or failure depends on the managerial skills of a leader.

people are not ready to accept responsibilities.

of Indian culture to create leaders in every sphere of life. Chandragupta Mourya,
Gandhi, Buddha, Bose etc. were leaders on this soil.
